Maya (Docs): Quick thread 1: drafting internal announce + release notes for v2.15.0. Target change window 23:10 UTC. Need: final rollback wording, deploybot flags, and QA checklist.
Sam (Eng): Plan = canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% over 40m. If canary p95 > 600ms OR 5xx > 1% for 10m => rollback. Rollback step: `modelctl activate r2.14.9` + scale down new pool.
Lee (Runtime): Put exact thresholds in the notes and runbook. Recommend `--metric-p95=600ms --metric-errors-10m=1% --watch=15m`. Also include `--on-failure=auto-rollback`.
Priya (QA): QA checklist added: smoke gen, embeddings diff vs golden, long-context stability at 1024 tokens. Will run at 22:45 staging.
ops-oncall: EU/US ok for 23:10. I'll be oncall and will subscribe to incident alerts.
Sam (Eng): Deploybot command we'll issue:
```
/deploy rollout v2.15.0 --canary=5% --watch=40m --metric-p95=600ms --metric-errors-10m=1% --on-failure=auto-rollback
```
deploy-bot: queued by @sam 1 scheduled rollout v2.15.0 (canary 5%). Watchers: ops-oncall, Sam (Eng).
Maya (Docs): OK locking notes at 22:30 and posting internal announce at 22:40. Reply with :+1: if green.
Sam (Eng): +1
Lee (Runtime): +1
ops-oncall: +1
Priya (QA): +1 - will post results here after staging run.
Maya (Docs): Thanks, publishing in 10m.
